name: Lucia Azevedo
source:
Lucia is a full-time student at Vesper University and a part-time employee at her family's store, Tech Works. She tries to spend the little free time and money she has on hanging out with her friends. She has an aura of cool that makes her one of the most popular girls at school, but she couldn't care less about popularity contests.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
